cases.input: Hello, I was charged $19 for the Pro plan but I cancelled it two weeks ago, before my exams started. Please refund me. Thanks, Karim
cases.expected_summary: Customer was charged $19 for a plan cancelled before renewal and asks for a refund.
cases.notes: Clear refund request. Mentions cancelling, but the intent is money back, so billing.

cases.input: Hi team, I'm in the middle of my final exams so I'm really stressed, sorry for the long message. Last month I upgraded to the yearly plan because of the student discount you advertised, but the invoice I got shows the full price with no discount applied. My university email is registered on the account. Could you check the invoice and correct the amount? Best, Salma
cases.expected_summary: Customer's yearly plan invoice does not show the advertised student discount and they ask for it to be corrected.
cases.notes: Long, stressed message with irrelevant details. The core issue is an invoice amount and pricing, so billing.

cases.input: I can't open my course materials since my payment failed yesterday, and now it says my subscription is suspended. My exam is on Friday, please fix this.
cases.expected_summary: Customer's subscription was suspended after a failed payment and they cannot access course materials before an exam.
cases.notes: Could be billing, account or technical. Rule used: the root cause is the failed payment, so billing.

cases.notes: Clear error report with an error code and a named feature.

cases.input: Hello support, I hope you're well. I've been using the flashcard feature for about a month and I love it, and my friends use it too. The problem is that since the last update, the cards I made on my laptop don't show up on my phone anymore, even though I'm logged in with the same email on both. I've restarted the app twice. Thanks a lot, Yassine
cases.expected_summary: Customer's flashcards created on a laptop no longer sync to their phone since the latest update.
cases.notes: Friendly tone and a mention of login could mislead toward account. The issue is a sync bug, so technical.

cases.input: Wow, great job. The site is down again the night before my exam. Really love paying for this.

cases.notes: Sarcastic tone. Mentions paying, which could suggest billing, but the real problem is an outage, so technical.

cases.input: Hi, I forgot my password and the reset link I received has expired. Can you send me a new one?

cases.input: Good evening. I recently changed university and got a new student email address. I would like to update the email on my profile so I keep my progress and notifications. cases.notes: Extra irrelevant detail. The "how to" wording might suggest technical, but it is a profile change, so account.
